Back office Spain

Spain support operations reviewed with volume capacity and staffing strategies and financial expense consolidation plans

Spain Support Operations Volume
Existing team handles inbound requests using current capacity and artificial intelligence tools while monitoring volume data.

Staffing Schedule Salesforce Access
Coverage aligns with operating hours while Salesforce redirection and artificial intelligence integration details require verification.

Financial Expense Consolidation Plans
Financial consolidation begins in November with expenses booked directly into the entity using NetSuite.

### Decisions
Needs Further Discussion
- Timeline for Finote financial consolidation: The group discussed whether financial consolidation with Finote should start in November or be rushed for the first month's closing, pending Cristhian's confirmation with Victor.

Aligned
- Prioritization of SOP and AI tools: The team aligned to prioritize setting up documentation, SOPs, and AI tools for WhatsApp and the app to handle initial support for Spain.
- Absorption of Spain support volume: The team agreed that the current support team capacity can absorb the low initial trip volume in Spain without hiring a full-time dedicated person at this stage.
- Geographic location for future support: If a support hire is needed in the future for Spain, the position should be located outside of Spain in regions like Argentina or Brazil to optimize costs and time zone differences.
- Rescheduling of meeting to Wednesdays: Rafael agreed to change the recurring meeting schedule to Wednesdays in order to include the Finote team.

### Next steps
- [Dan Rizzo] Update Support Documentation: Facilitate the creation of standard operating procedures and implement AI tools for the Spain support team. Oversee the integration of support resources into the existing application and WhatsApp framework.
- [Dan Rizzo] Consult Thiago: Verify with Thiago if the artificial intelligence activity can be directed to a separate Salesforce URL. Confirm the technical requirements for the Spain entity instance.
- [Cristhian Herrera] Book Monthly Expenses: Record all financial expenses within the entity for the current month. Ensure the ledger accurately reflects the costs provided by the partner.
- [Cristhian Herrera] Clarify Financial Plans: Confirm with Victor the timeline for financial consolidation and expense allocation steps. Provide an update once the details regarding the support team allocation are resolved.

### Details
Spain Support Operations and Current Volume: Dan Rizzo raised the immediate priority of establishing documentation and AI tools within the app and via WhatsApp to handle incoming support. Armando Flores noted that Danny and part of Arthur currently handle inbound support. Volume is only a couple of trips per day. Armando argued the current support team could absorb this volume without a dedicated full-time employee, while Dan Rizzo expressed concern about service quality if volume spikes. Jaqueline Sanches confirmed all support roles are filled except one open position being replaced with an in-house candidate. Consensus: existing team handles inbound using current capacity, leveraging AI tools to filter requests, monitoring volume data.

Staffing Schedule and Salesforce Access for Spain Operations: Seven-hour time difference. Staffing weighted toward US and Mexico hours, lighter early mornings and late evenings. Coverage runs until 10-11 PM weekdays, 8-9 PM Saturdays. Weekend volume not anticipated; Daniel Escribano confirmed trips possible on Saturdays but not Sundays. Spain uses a unique Salesforce instance; support team access must be confirmed. Dan Rizzo to verify Salesforce URL redirection and AI integration with Thiago.

Future Support Hiring Strategy and Location: Armando argued hiring outside Spain is more economical. Jaqueline suggested Argentina or Brazil. Consensus: SOPs and AI tools first, monitor volume, defer hiring.

Financial Consolidation and Expense Booking with Finote: Meeting moved to Wednesdays to include Finote. Cristhian Herrera: Finote runs independently for the current month; consolidation scheduled to begin in November pending confirmation from Victor; expenses booked directly into the entity using NetSuite. Armando noted Spain currently has no management allocation; Cristhian to confirm steps (booking expenses, consolidation, allocations) with Victor. Dan Rizzo suggested support allocation ~10% of one person plus a small management percentage.
